title: Part-2 Notice regarding Special Courts on 06.11.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2026, dated 05/11/2026.
Date: - 06/11/2026
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 06.11.2026;

FULL TEXT:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-01/2026, dated 05/11/2026.
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 06/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
In continuation of the Notice mentioned in the
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 06.11.2026;
1. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice Mr. Justice
Manash Ranjan Pathak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S.
Kariel would sit in Special Division Bench and take up the
notified matter/s.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 1 above,
Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice Mr. Justice Manash
Ranjan Pathak would sit Single and take up the
matters as per Roster.
3. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 1 above,
Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel would Sit Single and
take up the matters as per Roster.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
